result.description: The Astra Loom 27 is a fictional 27-inch reference monitor designed for typography work, color grading previews, and compact studio desktops. It uses a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel with a fixed 60 Hz refresh rate, USB-C input, and an integrated adjustable stand for everyday professional office use. The display emphasizes balanced color reproduction and low-glare viewing rather than gaming performance or high-end HDR workloads.
